# Extension x API matrix

Generated by `npm run api-matrix`, do not edit. Rules: [README.md](README.md).

Survey of 2026-10-30: top 200 of Open VSX by downloads without code-less themes and packs, plus the records of our registry: **204 extensions**. Upstream members: **2215**.

`require("vscode")` was not found in **1 of 204 bundles (0.5%)**; their usage below is "not found", not "none".

In **2** more the API object was found but no member was resolved (it is passed around as a value): `googlecloudtools.datacloud`, `ms-playwright.playwright`.

A member reached through a value (`editor.document.getText()`) has no syntactic link to the API, so interface members never show usage. False positives are possible; a zero means "not found".
